description: Capture SAY/SPEAK utterance tokens before the legacy noun parser tries to interpret them, and split natural question/exclamation punctuation cleanly

replacements.new:
<COND (<NOT ,SUPER-BRIEF> <CRLF>)>
	       <SETG P-SPOKEN-PTR 0>
	       <SETG P-SPOKEN-COUNT 0>
	       <TELL ">">
	       <READ ,P-INBUF ,P-LEXV>)>
	<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<COND (<AND <G? ,P-LEN 1>
		    <OR <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV .PTR> ,W?SAY>
			<EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV .PTR> ,W?SPEAK>>>
	       <SETG P-SPOKEN-PTR <+ .PTR ,P-LEXELEN>>
	       <SETG P-SPOKEN-COUNT <- ,P-LEN 1>>
	       <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 1>
	       <SETG P-LEN 1>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
